diagnosis.summary: 047 already proves the publisher trace, Livox source-topic stream, and IMU source-topic stream were monotonic in the single instrumented FAST-LIO-only run, while FAST-LIO logged exactly one callback-labeled imu_cbk loop-back. Static FAST-LIO source inspection confirms that this label is emitted only inside imu_cbk when the callback-local corrected IMU timestamp is less than last_timestamp_imu, then imu_buffer is cleared. Therefore 048 classifies the 047 blocker as FAST-LIO callback-local IMU timestamp/order state, not as publisher-side Livox regression or source-topic IMU header-stamp regression in that run.
not_enough_to_distinguish: stale DDS delivery into FAST-LIO subscriber callback
callback queue ordering under finite replay startup/end boundary
FAST-LIO time_diff_lidar_to_imu or time_sync_en timestamp adjustment edge
FAST-LIO internal last_timestamp_imu state handling after buffers drain

047_fastlio_outputs.claim_boundary: nonzero outputs are context only and are not FAST-LIO success or localization quality

fastlio_candidate_source.global_state: last_timestamp_lidar starts at 0 and last_timestamp_imu starts at -1.0.
fastlio_candidate_source.livox_callback: livox_pcl_cbk logs [mosim_diag][livox_pcl_cbk] only when !is_first_lidar and cur_time < last_timestamp_lidar; 047 livox_pcl_cbk count was 0.
fastlio_candidate_source.imu_callback: imu_cbk copies the incoming IMU, adjusts msg->header.stamp by time_diff_lidar_to_imu and optional timediff_lidar_wrt_imu, computes timestamp, and logs [mosim_diag][imu_cbk] only when timestamp < last_timestamp_imu before clearing imu_buffer.
fastlio_candidate_source.subscriber_depths: Livox subscription depth is 20 for CustomMsg; IMU subscription depth is 10 for sensor_msgs/Imu.

imu_publisher_source.observation: IMU publisher uses a reliable KeepLast(64) publisher, wall timer, node now() stamp, and publishes make_imu(row, base_index, stamp). The 047 recorded IMU topic stream was monotonic, so upstream IMU topic regression is not supported in this run.
